$comment: Spec-kit compatibility contract for Uroboros. Human-readable version: references/spec-kit-compat.md. Read by the run skill's compatibility check (skills/run/SKILL.md) and by /uroboros:compat (skills/compat/SKILL.md). Update it, the snapshot, and CHANGELOG.md together whenever a new spec-kit line is adopted.

policy.snapshot: one snapshot per spec-kit major.minor line, taken from the x.y.0 tag with a pristine `specify init` (see the snapshot's NOTICE.md); patches within a line are never snapshotted
policy.minor: a new minor gets a new snapshot, a row in the per-line review, and becomes the baseline
policy.major: a new major is never assumed compatible: the run skill asks before proceeding on such a project until the contract has been re-verified

baseline.method: pristine install of the v1.0.0 tag (Claude integration, skills mode, script ps, git extension); every touchpoint below checked on it

version_sources.meaning: version of the spec-kit that installed the Claude skills the run invokes (refreshed by `specify integration upgrade claude`)
version recorded when the project was initialized

cli.pristine_install: uvx --from git+https://github.com/github/spec-kit.git@v<version> specify init <dir> --integration claude --script ps --ignore-agent-tools --extension git (before 0.16.0: no --extension flag, run `specify extension add git` inside the project afterwards; --non-interactive exists from 1.0.0)

optional.speckit-git-feature: feature-branch creation (git extension); absent => the run continues branchless
optional.speckit-converge: convergence gate at the close of implement (spec-kit >= 0.11.2); absent => the gate is skipped and noted in loop-state.md

used_by: skills/run/SKILL.md (Phase -1 resume, step B artifact paths)

hook_directives.note: since 0.12.x (before the plugin existed) the skills tell the agent to actually invoke a mandatory hook and wait; `before_specify` -> `speckit.git.feature` has been mandatory (optional: false) in every version from 0.12.10 to 1.0.0. Uroboros is the hook executor (hard rule 2)
hook_directives.events_not_used: constitution, checklist and taskstoissues hooks (skills the loop never invokes) and implement hooks (the uroboros-implementer subagent replaces speckit-implement, so before/after_implement never fire)

policy.speckit.git.feature: skip when Phase 0.5 already created the branch
policy.optional: decline silently, record under DECLINED HOOKS, list in the Loop Report
policy.other_mandatory: invoke the named skill yourself and continue

artifact_conventions.convergence_section: ## Phase N: Convergence (append-only, tasks T{max+1}... with source-refs)
artifact_conventions.checklists_since_1_0: checklists/requirements.md is maintained by specify/clarify; implement treats checklist markers as a read-only gate (changed in 1.0.0)

snapshot.note: Projects initialized with `--script sh` differ from the snapshot only in the `.specify/scripts/...` paths inside the skills; treat those hunks as expected. 1.0.0 writes the git-extension skills with CRLF on Windows; the snapshot stores them normalized to LF.

history.note: built against (0.12.10 and 0.12.11 shipped that day)
contract introduced; every line from 0.12.10 reviewed by diff; full run
